t: This is the Parliamentary War Memorial, a stone sculpture in Westminster Hall, unveiled in 1922. It's also called the Recording Angel Memorial, and it was made by the Australian sculptor Bertram Mackennal. It names members of both Houses, senior staff, and the sons of members and officers who died in the First World War. Among them are Valentine Fleming, father of Ian Fleming, who created James Bond. The Irish MPs Tom Kettle and Willie Redmond are here too. So are Neil Primrose and Charles Lyell. Above it, a stained glass window remembers those lost in the Second World War.
